items.title: A股剧烈探底回升：科创50暴涨10.73%，创近一年最大单日涨幅，半导体ETF涨超19%
items.summary: 2026年7月21日，科创50指数触底强势反弹，收涨10.73%至1903.16点，半导体芯片ETF单日涨幅超19%；多只科技/芯片股触及涨停板，深成指涨4.81%，创业板指涨7.05%。此为科创50历史单日涨幅第三高。
items.why: A股半导体板块深V反转，直接影响HK半导体/科技标的联动预期；若强势持续，有助压缩相关港股期权隐含波动率、或催生Covered Call机会。

items.title: 证监会两日连开座谈会要求增强市场内在稳定性；全市场股票ETF连续11日净流入3567亿元，刷新单周历史纪录
items.summary: 证监会主席吴清7月20-21日分别召开座谈会，强调全力维护市场平稳运行，要求上市公司提升核心竞争力、更好回报投资者。同期，全市场股票ETF连续11个交易日净流入，区间累计达3567亿元；7月17日单日净流入758.67亿元为史上第三高，单周净流入突破2036亿元刷新历史纪录。
items.why: 监管层高规格密集表态叠加ETF历史性资金流入，显示政策底强化，有助于支撑中国权益资产估值；对持有港股/A股的仓位而言，整体市场情绪边际向好，Sell Put风险溢价或可适度收窄。

items.title: Alphabet GOOGL Q2 2026 earnings due after close today: Google Cloud est. +67% YoY to $22.8B; $180-190B AI capex in focus
items.summary: Alphabet reports Q2 2026 after market close July 22. Consensus: $116.98B revenue, $2.89-$2.95 EPS. Google Cloud seen at $22.8B (+67% YoY), following Q1's record 32.9% operating margin. Gemini API processing 16B tokens/minute (+60% QoQ). Full-year capex guidance raised to $180-190B. Gemini 3.5 Pro delays flagged as a risk heading into results.
items.why: 谷歌业绩是今夜美股科技板块另一焦点，云增速能否维持67%+直接影响AI基础设施叙事；超大规模capex考验AI投资回报预期，结果影响英伟达、英特尔等供应链标的隔日走势。

items.title: Trump orders fresh strikes on Iran nuclear/power sites; Brent crude surges 5%+; Dow drops 576 pts; IMF cuts 2026 growth to 3.0%
items.summary: President Trump declared the U.S.-Iran ceasefire 'over' in July and ordered fresh airstrikes on Iranian nuclear and power facilities (latest July 15). Brent crude settled +5.43% at $78.19/bbl, WTI +4.37%. The Dow fell 576 points on initial announcement; energy stocks gained while travel/airlines fell 2-3%. IMF downgraded 2026 global growth forecast to 3.0% (from 3.5%). Iran warned of retaliation.
items.why: 中东地缘冲突持续推升能源通胀，压制美联储降息空间；高油价对全球消费股（旅游/餐饮/海底捞/携程）构成逆风，同时推高市场整体隐含波动率，Sell Put需更高安全边际。

items.title: SK Hynix rockets +14% July 21 as chip stocks stage broad rebound; Micron +13% in tandem; July 29 earnings as next test
items.summary: SK Hynix (SKHY) surged 14% to $172.80 in U.S. trading on July 21, leading a broad AI chip and memory rally after a 10%+ monthly pullback (including a record single-day -15.4% on July 13). Micron rose 13% in sympathy, extending momentum from its blowout Q3 FY2026 ($41.46B revenue; Q4 guidance $50B ±$1B). SK Hynix Q2 earnings due July 29 will be the next verification of the HBM super-cycle narrative.
items.why: 存储芯片板块强势反弹印证HBM需求周期延续，对SK海力士、美光等持仓均有利；财报前高波动率可考虑Sell Put建仓策略，但需防范类似7月13日的黑天鹅波动。

items.title: Fed FOMC meeting July 28-29: rate hold at 3.50-3.75% widely expected; energy-driven inflation at 4.2% remains key risk
items.summary: Market-implied odds favor no rate change at ~79.5% at the July 28-29 FOMC meeting. June CPI showed 4.2% YoY inflation driven by a 23.5% surge in energy costs amid Middle East tensions. Fed June minutes noted AI investment, tariffs and Middle East as new potential inflation sources. 19.4% odds of a 25bp hike remain. Decision July 29 at 2pm ET.
items.why: 美联储政策路径直接影响美股估值折现率；若因油价推升通胀维持鹰派倾向，对高PE科技股和港股消费标的形成压力，也影响期权隐含利率曲线定价和整体风险溢价水平。

items.title: Intel Foundry lands Fortinet as first publicly named cybersecurity chip customer; co-developing next-gen firewall ASIC on Intel 4
items.summary: Intel and Fortinet announced July 21 that Fortinet will be Intel Foundry's first named external cybersecurity customer, using the Intel 4 process node (not 18A) to co-develop Fortinet's next-gen Security Processor 6 (SP6) ASIC for firewalls. Intel stock reclaimed the $100 level. This is CEO Lip-Bu Tan's first public foundry customer win since taking over in March 2025, ahead of Intel's Q2 earnings July 23.
items.why: 英特尔代工业务首获公开命名客户是里程碑，验证Foundry策略可信度；若7/23 Q2财报配合18A良率数据，可能推动INTC估值重估，对现有仓位可关注财报后Covered Call时机。

items.title: Nvidia discloses 9.3% stake in Nebius Group (NBIS) worth ~$5B via SEC filing; NBIS surges 13%+
items.summary: Nvidia disclosed in an SEC filing (July 21) that it holds ~22.3M Class A Nebius shares via outright ownership plus pre-funded warrants, raising its stake to 9.3% valued at ~$5B at current prices. The original $2B strategic investment was made March 11, 2026. Nebius, an AI cloud infrastructure company, jumped more than 13% on the news. Nvidia also guided Q2 revenue at ~$91B.
items.why: 英伟达战略扩股Nebius，显示其布局AI云基础设施生态的决心，印证AI算力需求旺盛；同时$91B Q2营收指引若兑现将进一步巩固NVDA多头逻辑，对整个AI供应链板块有积极示范效应。

items.title: Intel INTC Q2 2026 earnings tomorrow (July 23): 18A foundry yield at 85%; Apple/Microsoft as design partners; options pricing 15% swing
items.summary: Intel reports Q2 2026 on July 23 after market close. Street expects $14.42B revenue, $0.21 EPS. Key watch: Intel 18A foundry yield reportedly improved to 85% (from ~65%); Apple and Microsoft confirmed as 18A design partners; Nvidia and OpenAI reportedly placed foundry orders. Stock at ~$95.70, +163% YTD. Options pricing a ~15% post-earnings move.
items.why: 英特尔Q2是本周半导体赛道最大财报事件；18A良率若官方确认突破85%，将触发代工业务重估行情；期权隐含波动率高达15%，熟悉INTC的投资者可考虑Sell Straddle/Strangle，但需注意二元事件风险。

items.title: 腾讯牵头约136亿元（约20亿美元）收购AI Agent独角兽Manus，将成最大股东，强化微信智能体生态
items.summary: 2026年7月20日，腾讯牵头中国资本财团以约20亿美元估值从Meta手中赎回Manus全部股权，腾讯将成最大单一股东。此前Meta于2025年12月以同等价格收购Manus，但中国发改委外资安全审查终止了该交易。Manus当前ARR已从百万增至40-50亿美元，实际成交约4-5倍PS比；收购后Manus有望直接整合入微信/元宝AI生态。
items.why: 腾讯以相对低估的价格获取全球领先的AI Agent资产，有助落地微信智能体功能、巩固混元生态竞争力；对0700.HK是正面催化剂，可关注消息落地后估值修复空间，也适合结合回购进度布局Sell Put。

items.title: Tesla and Alphabet both report Q2 earnings tonight (Jul 22 US ET) — mega-cap double-header
items.summary: Tesla Q2: 480,126 deliveries (+25% YoY, first YoY growth in two years); consensus revenue ~$27.6B, GAAP EPS $0.36, gross margin ~19.5%. Alphabet Q2: consensus EPS $2.89, revenue $116.84B, Google Cloud focus after Q1 +63% YoY. Both report after US market close July 22.
items.why: 特斯拉+谷歌同日财报是全周最大事件风险；毛利率与云收入增速将分别定价两只核心持仓的期权波动率；结果公布后可能触发期权行权，建议在开盘前评估delta敞口。

items.title: Circle (CRCL) +8% on OCC national trust bank approval — first stablecoin issuer with federal banking charter
items.summary: Circle received final OCC approval (July 10) for Circle National Trust, the first federal banking charter for a stablecoin issuer. Stock jumped 8% on July 21 as bulls targeted $70. USDC circulation $73.2B (+19%). Visa's Open USD platform is key competitive risk; Mizuho downgraded to Underperform July 14.
items.why: Circle获联邦银行牌照建立监管护城河，直接强化USDC合规叙事；GENIUS Act立法环境利好；竞争风险Visa Open USD限制上行，CRCL仍在期权波动率高位，sell put需设置足够安全垫。

items.title: Apple Intelligence cleared in China with Alibaba Qwen as sole AI language partner — BABA ADRs +4.78%
items.summary: China's CAC approved Apple Intelligence on July 15, with Alibaba Qwen handling language tasks and Baidu handling visual search. Apple is the only foreign AI provider on the CAC list. Apple shares +4.01% to record $327.50; BABA ADRs +4.78%. Consumer rollout expected within weeks to months.
items.why: 阿里云AI商业化重大里程碑：Qwen成为Apple Intelligence在华唯一语言模型，直接提升阿里云收入潜力与估值天花板；9988.HK仓位可适度上移covered call行权价锁利，或sell更远虚值put。

items.title: AMD launches Helios AI rack system; Microsoft is first big customer — first genuine Nvidia rival in datacenter
items.summary: AMD unveiled Helios on July 20 integrating MI455X GPUs, EPYC Venice CPUs and 31TB HBM4 per rack, priced $5-5.5M. Microsoft Azure will deploy Helios for frontier model inference in H2 2026. First real competitor to Nvidia Blackwell/Vera Rubin; AMD stock +5%.
items.why: AI芯片市场竞争格局首次出现实质性系统级挑战；对英伟达长期护城河构成边际压力，同时利好AMD及HBM供应商SK海力士；持英伟达covered call仓位需注意股价上行受限风险。

items.title: 加息悬念拉满！美联储步入7月决议前噤声期，7月29日公布利率决议
items.summary: 美联储7月28-29日FOMC会议前正式进入噤声期。CME利率期货显示维持3.50-3.75%概率61.5%，加息25bp概率升至34.2%。18份点阵图中9份指向年末利率高于当前区间，降息叙事已被打破。
items.why: 美联储利率走向直接影响全球流动性与估值；若7月29日意外加息，成长股（腾讯、谷歌）及高PE标的将承压，sell put时需将加息风险纳入保证金计算。

items.title: 科创板迎来开市七周年：611家硬科技企业，三轮系统性改革持续推进
items.summary: 2026年7月22日，科创板正式开市七年。首批25家上市公司已扩展至611家硬科技军团。历经三轮系统性改革，集成电路、人工智能、生物医药三大板块日益壮大，资本市场服务新质生产力格局成型。
items.why: 政策积极背书科创板硬科技赛道；半导体与AI算力企业估值修复具有政策支撑，对A股科技ETF整体情绪利好，可关注相关板块sell put机会。

items.title: US confirms Nvidia H200 shipments to China begun — Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance cleared for 400K+ chips
items.summary: US Commerce Dept official confirmed H200 chips began shipping to ~10 Chinese firms including Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance and ZTE. Volume described as trivial. Total approved demand exceeds 400K units; Chinese buyers interested in 2M+ total. 25% tariff applies; case-by-case licensing in place.
items.why: 腾讯和阿里获批采购H200是AI算力投资的实质性里程碑，强化两家公司AI业务竞争力；Nvidia中国收入有增量但受政策不确定性制约；持有腾讯/阿里者可观察H200到位后对业绩的拉动效应。

items.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Q2 guidance ~$91B; H200 China shipments begin; AMD Helios introduces new competition
items.summary: NVDA trades near $207 with Q2 revenue guidance ~$91B vs Q1 record $81.6B. H200 limited shipments to China now active. Goldman Sachs notes forward P/E at 21.7x vs 5-year avg 72x. AMD Helios introduces first rack-level AI system competition.
items.why: 英伟达Q2指引$91B需求强劲，中国H200出货是收入增量；AMD Helios令竞争预期转变但短期影响有限；高盛指出21.7倍前瞻PE历史偏低，sell put护城河逻辑仍完整，留意AMD竞争进展。
items.source: FX Leaders / Goldman Sachs via Longbridge

items.title: Intel (INTC) regains $100 — Fortinet joins as first cybersecurity foundry customer; Q2 earnings Thursday Jul 23
items.summary: Intel stock reclaimed $100 on July 21 after Fortinet selected its 18A foundry process — the first cybersecurity sector customer. Q2 earnings due July 23: consensus $14.4B revenue, $0.22 non-GAAP EPS. Foundry division still posting $2.4B+ operating losses per quarter; HSBC raised target to $200.
items.why: 英特尔代工18A首次拿下网络安全客户，验证其向外部扩张能力；明日7/23财报是短期方向催化剂；期权隐含波动率高企，卖put须注意代工亏损是否超预期。

items.title: Laopu Gold (6181.HK) down 65% from peak — gold fell from $5,600 to below $4,000; counter-cyclical price hike backfired
items.summary: Laopu Gold shares near HK$370, down ~65% from July 2025 peak of HK$1,065. Gold prices fell ~30% from ~$5,600/oz to below $4,000. The company's Feb 2026 avg 20-30% price hike while rivals cut prices created severe demand headwinds. Nomura cut target to HK$905.
items.why: 老铺黄金已从顶部大幅调整，若黄金止跌企稳存在逆向修复机会；但定价策略失当与金价继续下行风险并存，估值修复节奏难判断，卖put须设置充足缓冲。

items.title: SK Hynix (SKHY) post-IPO whipsaws — Korean shares plunged 15.4%; HBM4E 12-layer samples shipped
items.summary: After the $26.5B Nasdaq IPO debut (+13% on July 10), SKHY whipsawed as Korean shares plunged 15.4% on arbitrage selling, dragging Kospi down 9%. Separately, SK Hynix confirmed shipment of 12-layer HBM4E samples (48GB capacity, 2TB/s bandwidth) to key customers.
items.why: SK海力士三地价差剧烈是持仓风险点；HBM4E样品发货领先竞争对手，HBM4量产Q3验证在即；CSOP两倍做多产品波动率大幅放大，需设置止损。

items.title: Stock futures climb ahead of corporate earnings, Nasdaq rebounds: Live updates
items.summary: US stock futures rose Tuesday as investors braced for a flurry of earnings reports amid signs of revival in chip stocks. Nasdaq-100 contracts jumped 1.3%, with semiconductor names taking center stage ahead of Big Tech results (Tesla and Alphabet both report July 22).
items.why: 纳斯达克期货大涨1.3%，半导体领涨，科技财报季高峰来临，持有相关美股期权需注意财报前后波动率变化。

items.title: Apple Intelligence approved for launch in China with Alibaba's Qwen AI
items.summary: China's CAC approved Apple Intelligence on July 15, with Alibaba Qwen handling ~65% of multimodal tasks and Baidu managing ~35% for Siri voice/search. The process took 22 months. No launch date announced yet; regulatory green light is now in place.
items.why: 通义千问成为Apple Intelligence在华核心AI供应商，实质性提升阿里云商业化空间，对阿里巴巴估值有正面催化；也可能推动iPhone在华销量反弹。

items.title: Alibaba Stock Surges As Apple AI Deal Fuels New Rally
items.summary: BABA surged on July 20 driven by four catalysts: Apple Intelligence approval, DOJ $600M non-prosecution deal ($325M penalty), Morgan Stanley Overweight with triple-digit AI cloud growth, and stock approaching key technical levels. Stock up ~4.6% on the day.
items.why: DOJ和解移除重大法律尾险，苹果AI合作打开增量营收，配合摩根士丹利维持增持，阿里估值修复逻辑清晰，对sell put策略支撑明显。

items.title: Micron Says Memory Chip Supply Will Remain Tight Beyond 2027
items.summary: Micron disclosed it is sold out of HBM capacity for both 2026 and 2027, and expects broad memory market tightness to extend beyond 2027. The company recently signed 16 multiyear customer contracts—unprecedented in the memory industry—as AI compute demand drives structurally higher ASPs.
items.why: 美光HBM供应售罄至2027年以后，多年合同锁定高价，是极强的长线看涨信号；对持有MU正股和sell put策略均利好，关注内存赛道持续涨价逻辑。

items.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Week Review: EU Hit, Gemini Delays, Earnings Wednesday
items.summary: Alphabet reports Q2 2026 earnings July 22. Shares at $346.77 amid a $4.67B EU antitrust fine (Android/DMA) and Gemini 3.5 Pro delays. Q2 consensus: revenue $116.9B, EPS $2.90. Google Cloud accelerated to $20B/quarter (+63% YoY) in Q1.
items.why: 谷歌财报与特斯拉同日发布，将定调本周科技板块情绪；EU罚款与Gemini延迟是重大下行风险，期权隐含波动率已升高，财报后需关注IV崩塌。

items.title: Oil prices dip as mediation efforts offset U.S.-Iran strikes
items.summary: Oil softened Tuesday with Brent near $90/bbl as mediators pushed for a 10-day U.S.-Iran ceasefire, even as attacks entered a 10th consecutive day. A Houthi naval blockade threat on Saudi Arabia capped any sustained pullback.
items.why: 油价高位震荡叠加停火预期，影响通胀预期和美联储加息路径，是对冲持仓和期权策略的重要宏观背景。

items.title: Tesla rides robotaxi momentum into earnings season (Q2 results July 22)
items.summary: Tesla reports Q2 2026 earnings after market close July 22. Q2 deliveries hit 480,126 vehicles (+25% YoY), its strongest quarter since Q3 2025. Robotaxi now operates in 5 cities; Texas fleet scaled to 175 vehicles. 2026 capex guidance raised to $25B from $20B.
items.why: 特斯拉明日财报是市场催化剂，Robotaxi进展和毛利率是关键看点，财报前后隐含波动率将大幅变动，持有TSLA期权者需特别关注。

items.title: 深"V"，涨停潮！半导体大爆发，多只ETF大涨10%！
items.summary: A股7月21日全天呈深V形态，科创50指数收涨10.73%，创2026年最大单日涨幅；科创半导体ETF大涨逾19%，集成电路ETF、芯片ETF涨停；华虹宏力涨超17%。上证综指涨1.79%，创业板指涨7.05%。
items.why: A股半导体全线爆发是重大市场事件，若持有半导体相关个股或期权，隐含波动率大涨，sell put方向需警惕短期回调。

items.title: ETF收评：科创50暴力反弹涨超10%，AI硬件反攻，科创半导体ETF涨超19%，集成电路ETF、芯片ETF涨停
items.summary: 科创板、创业板强势反弹，多只半导体ETF创历史大涨纪录，AI硬件板块全线上扬。科创半导体ETF单日净值涨幅超19%，上半年该类ETF已累计涨逾177%。
items.why: 科创半导体ETF单日大涨19%，短期波动率骤升，持有相关正股或期权需关注次日波动率压缩风险。

items.title: 港股收评：恒指跌0.04% 科指涨1.32% 黄金股普涨 半导体、PCB板块大涨 智谱涨超36%
items.summary: 港股7月21日三指分化：恒生指数收跌0.04%报25132，恒生科技指数涨1.32%；华虹宏力涨超17%，建滔积层板涨超12%，紫金黄金国际涨超10%，智谱AI涨超36%。
items.why: 港股科技指数逆势上扬，华虹宏力创单日大涨，半导体主题继续受资金青睐，对相关港股期权隐含波动率有拉升作用。

items.title: China's Politburo July meeting seen accelerating fiscal delivery, not new stimulus
items.summary: Analysts expect the late-July Politburo meeting to call for faster implementation of existing infrastructure projects and possible front-loading of Q4 bond quotas. Roughly RMB 6.8 trillion of approved government bonds remain unissued; Beijing is unlikely to announce major new packages.
items.why: 政治局信号若偏积极财政，将提振A股和港股消费科技板块情绪，对国内消费相关标的期权是潜在正面催化。

items.title: China's Xiaomi unveils SUV series dubbed Sky Nomad (new EREV brand)
items.summary: Xiaomi officially confirmed Sky Nomad (Pengcheng/澎城) on July 8 — a standalone EREV SUV brand competing with Li Auto and AITO. First model Kunlun N3 is a 5.3m+, 7-seat full-size EREV with 70kWh+ battery, priced RMB 200k-450k. Xiaomi shares surged 10% intraday on announcement.
items.why: 小米推出独立增程品牌澎城，直接挑战理想汽车和AITO，扩大EV赛道布局；当日股价涨10%说明市场正面解读，对小米sell put有支撑。

items.title: China Renaissance Moves Trip.com (TCOM) to Hold on Antitrust Overhang
items.summary: China Renaissance downgraded Trip.com (TCOM/9961.HK) to Hold with a $42 target on July 2, citing unresolved antitrust investigation. BofA also cut its target from $78 to $64 (maintained Buy), noting a 'modest' Q1 beat but weak Q2 outlook and antitrust uncertainty.
items.why: 携程反垄断调查悬而未决是重大不确定性，多家机构下调目标价，对sell put策略的保护垫变薄，需重新评估行权价选择。

items.title: 美联储6月会议纪要确认鹰派转向，9月加息概率升至51.5%；7月28-29日FOMC会议临近
items.summary: 美联储6月会议纪要显示多数官员对通胀担忧加剧，加息呼声升温；CME FedWatch显示9月会议加息概率已升至51.5%。当前联邦基金利率维持3.50%-3.75%。7月28-29日FOMC会议将发布决议，本次无点阵图更新，市场焦点在声明措辞变化。
items.why: 再加息预期是港股美股估值的核心风险因子；利率上行压缩成长股估值倍数，同时提升sell put的安全垫要求，近期业绩期前需审视期权行权价配置。

items.title: US Strikes Iran for Ninth Straight Night; Iran Signals Possible Talks — Crude Holds Near $82.43
items.summary: The US conducted airstrikes on Iran for a ninth consecutive night; Iran retaliated with missile strikes on US allies. An Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson said negotiations with the US could resume if aligned with Iran's national interests. Crude oil steadied near $82.43/bbl, balancing escalation risk against diplomatic signals.
items.why: 中东地缘局势是全球通胀的核心变量；若谈判信号落实，油价下行可缓解美联储加息压力、利好风险资产；持续紧张则强化鹰派路径，需关注下周FOMC。

items.title: 证监会主席吴清走进营业部直面散户座谈，聚焦量化交易、分红、中长期资金入市
items.summary: 7月20日，证监会党委书记、主席吴清亲赴证券营业部，与8名大中小散户代表面对面座谈，听取投资者对量化交易监管、信披透明度、分红机制和中长期资金入市的意见。吴清表示广大投资者是市场之本，将全力维护资本市场平稳运行。
items.why: 监管层主动接触散户传递政策托底信号；量化交易监管预期趋严可能影响市场波动率结构，与sell put策略的隐含波动率敞口相关，需持续关注后续政策落地细节。

items.title: 月之暗面宣布最快6个月内赴港上市，Kimi K3发布后ARR三个月三倍增至3亿美元
items.summary: 月之暗面已向主要投资人提交港股上市议案，预计最快6个月内完成。驱动力是Kimi K3（7月16日发布，2.8万亿参数，当前全球最大开源模型）引发全球关注，ARR从3月1亿、5月2亿到6月3亿美元，三个月实现三倍跃升；API收入占比突破70%。最新参考估值约200亿美元。
items.why: 中国AI原生公司快速走向港股上市，为港股科技板块引入新高成长标的；Kimi K3跻身顶级开源模型的商业化进展值得跟踪，也为腾讯阿里等AI布局的相对估值提供新参照。

items.title: 花旗将中国股市评级上调至超配，恒生指数年底目标29600点
items.summary: 花旗7月20日将新兴市场中国股票评级由战术中性上调至超配，同步将韩国下调至中性。理由为中国股票仓位偏轻、估值合理、宏观环境改善及低油价。设恒生指数年底目标29600点、MSCI中国目标92美元（较当前约31%上行空间）；CSI 300目标5600点。
items.why: 花旗超配升评是本轮外资回流港股A股的重要催化；恒指目标29600较当前25127点有约18%空间，消费和互联网重仓股的估值中枢受益，但需注意资金从韩国轮出后芯片板块可能存在分化。

items.title: 五大万亿险企（人保、人寿、平安、太保、新华）集体发声支持资本市场，股票投资合计2.5万亿
items.summary: 7月20日，中国人保、中国人寿集团、中国平安、中国太保、新华保险五大万亿级保险机构集体公开表态坚定支持资本市场。数据显示，A股五大上市险企2025年末股票投资额合计达2.5万亿元，较2024年末大增逾1万亿元（+75%）。同期，中国诚通已增持近百亿、国新控股已增持超500亿元国资央企股票。
items.why: 险资是A股最大长线买家，集体表态与实际大规模增持双管齐下，对重仓的消费和科技核心标的估值构成直接支撑。

items.title: Alphabet GOOGL Q2 Earnings Wednesday (7/22): Google Cloud 60%+ Growth Eyed, EPS Est. $2.89
items.summary: Alphabet reports Q2 2026 after the bell on July 22. Consensus: EPS $2.89 (+23.8% YoY), revenue $116.84B (+21.2% YoY). Key watch: whether Google Cloud sustains ~60% growth (Q1 was +63%), and whether $190B 2026 capex guidance squeezes margins. Strong AI monetization across Search and Cloud is the bull thesis.
items.why: 谷歌是AI广告+云双引擎，明日业绩是美股科技估值中枢的重要锚定；Cloud能否延续60%增速直接影响市场对AI商业化前景的定价，进而传导至港股互联网板块情绪。

items.title: 7月以来股票型ETF净流入超3200亿元，宽基ETF成交额创2024年10月以来新高
items.summary: 7月以来沪深两市股票型ETF净流入超3200亿元，宽基ETF成为核心配置方向；7月20日尾盘多只宽基ETF放量，成交额创2024年10月中旬以来新高，增量资金持续积极布局A股市场。
items.why: 国家队加持+ETF资金持续流入是A股当前核心支撑力；3200亿规模较7月初预期大幅超出，市场做多情绪偏强，有助维持消费和科技重仓股估值。

items.title: 腾讯7月2-3日连续回购逾229万股，合计耗资约10亿港元；Q1净利679亿同比+11%
items.summary: 腾讯控股7月2日回购114.6万股耗资5.008亿港元、7月3日再回购114.9万股耗资5.01亿港元，两日合计逾10亿港元。Q1净利润679亿元，同比+11%；微信及WeChat合并MAU 14.32亿稳定。市值近期有所回落，AI布局滞后（元宝MAU仅5735万，远落后于豆包3.45亿）是主要压制；公司已于7月6日发布混元Hy3正式版加速追赶。
items.why: 高强度持续回购是股价下方的重要支撑，配合强劲的Q1业绩；AI追赶若提速，估值重评预期可能带动反弹；持有腾讯相关sell put时，回购支撑有助于守住行权价。
items.source: FX168财经网（据港交所披露易）

items.title: Intel INTC Q2 Earnings Thursday (7/23): 18A-P in Risk Production, Apple/Microsoft Foundry Clients
items.summary: Intel reports Q2 2026 on July 23. Guidance: revenue $13.8B-$14.8B, non-GAAP EPS ~$0.20, gross margin ~39%. Catalysts: 18A-P node entered risk production on schedule; Apple and Microsoft partnership for Intel Foundry validates the roadmap. Stock +160% YTD but pulled back to $101-$103 ahead of earnings. HSBC raised target to $200 citing foundry momentum. Foundry division still posting $2.4B+ operating loss.
items.why: 18A进入风险生产是英特尔估值重构的关键节点，苹果微软代工合作是首个财报验证机会；留意代工亏损收窄幅度是否符合扭亏时间表，这是估值修复的核心变量。

items.title: 老铺黄金股价较历史高点跌逾67%，市值蒸发超1200亿港元；天猫Q2销售额同比降63%
items.summary: 老铺黄金（6181.HK）股价较历史峰值下跌逾67%，市值蒸发超1200亿港元。天猫旗舰店Q2销售额同比大降63%，成都门店客流明显转淡。背景：国际金价从今年1月高位约5599美元/盎司大幅回落至7月中旬约3973美元，金价下跌打击公司高溢价库存策略和品牌溢价支撑。
items.why: 金价大幅回落是老铺黄金最主要的基本面逆风；若持有相关头寸，需重新评估金价下行路径对公司收入结构的影响，古法金赛道整体吸引力随金价波动而显著变化。
items.source: 大纪元（据公开数据汇总）

items.title: 港交所回应：正探讨取消午间休市、提早至9时开市及增设深夜盘后交易
items.summary: 市场传闻港交所研究延长股票交易时间：拟将开市提前至9:00（现9:30）、取消12:00-13:00午间休市，并增设晚间8:00至午夜盘后交易时段，以承接美国早盘活动。港交所回应称目前仍处早期探讨阶段，当前首要工作是延长衍生品市场交易时段。
items.why: 若落地，港股与A股、美股的交叉时段大幅增加，对日内期权策略和delta对冲窗口有实质影响；现阶段观察为主，无需立即调整。

items.title: 泡泡玛特股价较峰值跌55.7%，段永平斥资约15.89亿港元增持成第二大股东；PTS年度展会取消
items.summary: 泡泡玛特（9992.HK）截至7月10日收盘于150.7港元，较2025年8月峰值333.8港元下跌55.7%。知名投资者段永平（中国巴菲特）增持约1059万股，斥资约15.89亿港元升任第二大股东。近期Labubu新系列产品二级市场跌破发行价、原定7月24日至8月2日的PTS上海潮玩嘉年华已宣布取消，单IP依赖风险被加速定价。
items.why: 段永平价值派大额买入是重要的向下支撑信号；但Labubu新品破发和PTS取消是实质负面，需观察下季度GMV以判断IP生命周期拐点，这直接影响期权行权价合理区间的判断。

items.title: ASML Q2 2026 Beats: Net Sales EUR 9.3B, Raises 2026 Outlook to EUR 43-45B; Intel Foundry Confirmed Using High-NA EUV for 18A
items.summary: ASML reported Q2 2026 net sales of EUR 9.3B and net income of EUR 2.9B, raising 2026 full-year net sales guidance to EUR 43B-45B. ASML confirmed Intel Foundry is now mass-producing Panther Lake client CPUs on 18A process using high-NA EUV lithography — a critical milestone for Intel's foundry turnaround ahead of INTC Q2 earnings on July 23.
items.why: ASML业绩验证AI算力资本开支持续景气；英特尔18A量产确认是代工业务拐点信号，关注INTC Q2（7/23）能否引发估值修复行情。

items.title: 美伊军事冲突持续：美国对伊朗沿海防线发动多轮空袭，油价维持近月高位，美股承压
items.summary: 美国持续空袭伊朗沿海防线及导弹基地，布伦特原油维持近一个月高位约84美元；标普500于7月20日跌0.19%至7,443，道指跌307点；伊朗警告可能动员胡塞武装封锁红海原油通道，霍尔木兹海峡航运大幅萎缩。
items.why: 地缘冲突推升油价与通胀预期，令美联储下周加息概率上升；市场波动率抬头对Sell Put持仓构成Gamma风险，需关注VIX动向。

items.title: 英特尔INTC：Q2财报7月23日发布，预期EPS 0.20美元（去年同期-0.10美元），高NA EUV量产确认利多
items.summary: 英特尔Q2财报将于7月23日发布：预期营收143亿美元（+11% YoY），EPS 0.20美元 vs 上年-0.10美元；ASML已确认英特尔18A节点采用高NA EUV量产Panther Lake处理器，产能改善；AMD数据中心Q1首超英特尔（58亿 vs 51亿美元）竞争压力持续。
items.why: 18A量产落地是代工故事关键拐点，若Q2超预期可带动估值修复；AMD竞争与台积电份额保卫是潜在下行风险。

items.title: 特斯拉TSLA Q2财报将于7月22日盘后发布：480K交付创纪录，期权隐含波动7.6%超历史均值
items.summary: 特斯拉Q2交付量480,126辆（同比+25%）再创历史新高；分析师预期Q2营收约258亿美元、EPS约0.52美元（同比+30%）；财报前期权隐含涨跌幅达7.6%，高于历史均值4.4%；市场重点关注汽车毛利率恢复、Robotaxi扩张及Optimus进展。
items.why: 财报前高隐波是Sell Put或Covered Call的时间价值收割窗口；若毛利率改善超预期则下行风险有限，反之需控制仓位。

items.title: 港股恒生指数7月21日大涨582点（+2.4%）至25,143，中资科技消费全线反弹
items.summary: 恒指7月21日急弹582点收于25,143点，为亚洲表现最强主要指数；腾讯涨3.5%、美团涨3.2%、小米涨3.2%、快手涨4.6%；北京宣布两大国有基金新增增持权益，A股情绪联动提振，中资科技与消费板块集体走强。
items.why: 核心港股持仓（腾讯、美团、小米等）当日普遍上行，短期Sell Put行权压力缓解；但单日急涨后需注意隐含波动率收缩窗口。

items.title: 阿里巴巴9988.HK：发布通义千问Qwen3.8（2.4万亿参数），盘中涨3.7%，AI溢价尚未充分体现
items.summary: 阿里巴巴发布通义千问Qwen3.8开源模型，参数规模达2.4万亿，将开放权重并率先接入代码工具；港股9988当日收涨3.7%至HK$116.80，上周累涨约17.7%；分析师指AI溢价尚未充分体现于当前估值。
items.why: Qwen系列持续迭代强化阿里云护城河，开放权重策略可加速企业渗透；阿里云AI与淘天电商双轮驱动，中期估值重估空间明显。

items.title: 英伟达NVDA跌破200美元关键支撑；DeepSeek传言自研AI芯片；费城半导体指数确认技术熊市
items.summary: NVDA跌至200美元支撑位附近，据路透社DeepSeek正秘密研发自有AI芯片以减少对Nvidia依赖，为今年第三次国产硅利空；费城半导体指数（SOX）较6月高点累跌逾20%进入技术熊市，本周周线跌约10%；Nvidia 2026财年创纪录营收2,160亿美元（+65% YoY）。
items.why: DeepSeek自研芯片若规模化落地将压制NVDA长期定价权；SOX技术熊市信号影响持有AI芯片期权的仓位管理，需关注Vega风险。

items.title: 比特币跌至约60,000美元关口，加密市场承压于ETF净赎回与美联储加息预期
items.summary: 比特币跌入60,000美元区间，以太坊在1,750-1,800美元区间徘徊；美联储加息预期上升、ETF净赎回及资本轮动至AI资产形成三重压力；Standard Chartered维持年末100,000美元目标，但市场共识偏向70,000-75,000美元。
items.why: 加密市场疲软影响Circle/USDC业务环境；GENIUS Act落地使稳定币监管框架更清晰，但整体加密Beta下行需控制CRCL仓位风险。

items.title: Brent Crude Tops $90 as US-Iran Conflict Escalates, Hormuz Shipping Disrupted
items.summary: Brent crude surged 3% to $90.79/barrel on July 20 as the US and Iran exchanged strikes for a ninth consecutive night. Shipping through the Strait of Hormuz fell to four vessels Sunday from eight the prior day, raising energy supply disruption fears.
items.why: 布伦特破$90直接拉高通胀预期，加大美联储9月加息概率；对成长科技持仓Sell Put选手需关注隐含波动率上行风险，能源成本压力亦传导至消费赛道。

items.title: 30-Year Treasury Yield at 5.06%; Bond Market Signals 64% Odds of September Fed Rate Hike
items.summary: The 30-year Treasury yield stood at 5.06% as of July 19, near pre-2008-crisis highs. The 6-month yield sits 30bp above the Fed Funds rate. Markets now price a 64% probability of a September rate hike as oil-driven inflation expectations rise following the Iran conflict escalation.
items.why: 长端利率企稳5%以上压缩成长股估值倍数；美联储9月加息预期若进一步升温，将对Sell Put行权价安全边际形成系统性考验，适合在7月29日FOMC前降低delta敞口。

items.title: CXMT Prices $8.6B Shanghai IPO — Asia's Largest of 2026; STAR Market Listing Set for July 27
items.summary: ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) priced its Shanghai IPO at 8.66 yuan/share, raising 57.9 billion yuan ($8.6B) — the largest A-share semiconductor offering ever and Asia's biggest IPO of 2026. Subscription was oversubscribed 200x+ though at a lower pace than typical Chinese IPOs. Listing date: July 27.
items.why: CXMT上市是中国DRAM国产化战略标志性事件，对美光、SK海力士构成中长期竞争威胁；抽血A股流动性短期拖累科技板块，7月27日挂牌后存储芯片股波动可能加剧。

items.title: Nvidia Implements 'Whitelist' for Asian AI Chip Buyers; Over Half of Customers Cut Under BIS Compliance
items.summary: Nvidia deployed a new customer whitelist system for Asian AI chip sales on July 14, sending field staff to inspect data centers and interview end-users. Over half of previous Asian buyers have failed the enhanced BIS-aligned compliance checks. The system targets Singapore, Malaysia, and Japan to prevent chip diversion to China.
items.why: 英伟达主动缩减亚洲合规客户相当于自我限量，短期影响亚洲订单；但Blackwell/Rubin产能被顶级云客户吃满，长期减少监管风险。持有NVDA需关注下季度亚洲渠道订单变化。

items.title: China Stocks Tumble: Shanghai -3%, Shenzhen -5.4% as CXMT's $8.6B IPO Stirs Liquidity Panic
items.summary: Shanghai Composite plunged 3.05% to near 11-month low of 3,764 on July 17; Shenzhen Component fell 5.4%. Investors fear CXMT's 57.9bn-yuan ($8.6B) STAR Market IPO will drain market liquidity, compounded by upcoming mega-IPOs from Unitree and Yangtze Memory Technologies.
items.why: A股流动性恐慌直接拖累港股情绪，本周港股互联网板块（腾讯、阿里、美团等）可能承压；CXMT 7月27日挂牌前后是关键观察窗口。

items.title: US Stocks Post Worst Week in Three Months: Nasdaq -2.9%, S&P 500 -1.6% on AI Capex Slowdown Fears
items.summary: The Nasdaq lost 2.9% and the S&P 500 fell 1.6% for the week ending July 17 — the worst weekly performance in three months. Chip stocks led declines (Nvidia -2.2%, AMD -1%, Intel -2%) on concerns AI hyperscalers may cut infrastructure spending.
items.why: AI基建投入收缩传闻触发芯片板块系统性下跌，直接影响英伟达、英特尔、美光等持仓；本周Q2财报季（特斯拉、谷歌、英特尔）是情绪能否修复的关键观察窗口。

items.title: Futu moomoo Singapore: Private Wealth AUM +158% YoY; MooFest 2026 Held July 18 at Marina Bay Sands
items.summary: Moomoo Singapore reported private wealth AUM growth of 158% YoY with 40 External Asset Managers, per its July 20 announcement. Global IBKR-comparison: 5.185M client accounts (+34% YoY) and client equity of $930.3B (+40% YoY). MooFest 2026 was held July 18 at Marina Bay Sands. Caveat: Futu also faces securities fraud lawsuits filed in early July following regulatory penalties.
items.why: 富途私人财富AUM增速亮眼；但7月初遭遇证券欺诈诉讼（监管罚款引发股价跌27%）是显著法律风险。业务增长与尾部法律风险并存，Sell Put策略需留意判决时点带来的波动。

items.title: SK hynix Ships 12-Layer HBM4E Samples; Record 4 TB/s Bandwidth, 37% Faster Than HBM4
items.summary: SK hynix shipped 12-layer HBM4E samples to major customers in early July, achieving 48GB capacity, 16 Gbps per-pin speed (+37% vs HBM4 at 12 Gbps), 4 TB/s total bandwidth, and 20%+ power efficiency improvement. Heat resistance improved 17% for stable operation in high-performance AI computing.
items.why: SK海力士HBM4E样品出货稳固其AI内存市场技术领先地位（全球约50-55%份额），强化英伟达Rubin GPU的独供关系；港股南方两倍做多SK海力士ETF（7709.HK）持有者可关注技术护城河带来的溢价支撑。

items.title: Pop Mart LABUBU Makes Historic FIFA World Cup Opening Ceremony Debut — First Chinese IP Since 1930
items.summary: LABUBU appeared as two giant mascots at the 2026 FIFA World Cup opening ceremony on June 12 — the first Chinese original IP to perform at a World Cup since the tournament began in 1930. The LABUBU x FIFA collection drove sustained restock demand through the tournament, which concluded July 19.
items.why: Labubu登上FIFA世界杯开幕式是泡泡玛特IP出海史上最大级别的全球曝光里程碑；世界杯刚于7月19日落幕，后续销量与联名复购数据将验证品牌破圈转化效果，是9992.HK估值重估的重要催化剂。

items.title: 蜜雪冰城美国首店落地洛杉矶好莱坞，全球化出海再下一城
items.summary: 蜜雪冰城（2097.HK）首家美国门店在洛杉矶好莱坞正式开业，成为首个进入美国市场的中国连锁茶饮品牌。蜜雪冰城目前全球门店数近6万家，已布局东南亚、澳大利亚等市场，美国门店是其国际化战略的重要里程碑。
items.why: 蜜雪冰城进入全球最大消费市场是关键出海里程碑，对港股2097.HK有正向情绪提振；美国门店运营成本与客流量将成为检验品牌出海能力的重要样本，投资者可期待后续营运数据披露。

items.title: Interactive Brokers Q2 Earnings Due Today (July 21); Client Accounts +34% YoY to 5.185M
items.summary: Interactive Brokers reports Q2 2026 earnings after market close today. June client accounts reached 5.185 million (+34% YoY) with client equity of $930.3 billion (+40% YoY). Consensus EPS: $0.61/share; the broker has a 4-quarter average earnings surprise of +11.7%. Higher Q2 market volatility is expected to boost trading commissions.
items.why: 盈透今日发布Q2财报，高市场波动率（中东冲突+AI板块动荡）对券商交易收入是正催化；可与富途对比观察互联网券商竞争格局；期权交易量上升对IBKR收入贡献值得重点关注。

items.title: Trip.com Partners with Seat Unique to Add 500,000+ VIP Sports & Event Packages for APAC Travelers
items.summary: Trip.com Group and UK's Seat Unique announced a global partnership listing 500,000+ official hospitality and VIP live-event packages on Trip.com's platform, targeting Asia-Pacific travelers seeking curated sports and entertainment experiences. The deal broadens Trip.com's premium offerings beyond transport and hotels.
items.why: 携程VIP赛事套餐合作丰富高毛利产品矩阵，有助提升ARPU；在出境游加速复苏背景下，差异化高端产品有利于用户留存。但China Renaissance近期下调至持有评级，整体估值压力需关注。

items.title: CXMT Seeks $8.55B in Marquee IPO — Asia's Biggest IPO of 2026, Listing July 27 on STAR Market; A-share liquidity drain fears emerge
items.summary: China's ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) priced its STAR Market IPO at 8.66 yuan/share, raising ~57.9 billion yuan ($8.55B) — the largest Chinese A-share semiconductor IPO ever, surpassing SMIC's 2020 offering. Shares list July 27. Simultaneously, Unitree Robotics received regulatory IPO approval for STAR Board. The Shanghai Composite fell 3.05% the prior week amid concerns that CXMT plus upcoming mega-listings could drain market liquidity.
items.why: A 股史上最大芯片 IPO 即将挂牌（7月27日），近期流动性已受冲击（上证综指周跌3.05%）；CXMT 若量产 HBM 将对 SK 海力士/美光形成竞争压力，需关注其技术进度对 HBM 定价格局的影响。

items.title: Google Gemini 3.5 Pro launch delayed — Bloomberg exclusive: internal goals missed, engineers fear falling behind Anthropic and OpenAI
items.summary: Bloomberg reported July 16 that Google is months behind schedule on Gemini 3.5 Pro, its most capable AI model, due to unmet coding and reasoning targets. Internal engineers and managers are frustrated, with many worried Google risks losing its AI competitive edge. Separately, Google said Gemini has crossed 900 million monthly users in 230+ countries; Chrome Gemini features rolled out to UK users July 14.
items.why: 谷歌 AI 旗舰模型延迟发布暴露其与 Anthropic/OpenAI 竞争差距，短期利空 GOOG/GOOGL 估值；AI 军备竞赛溢价可能更多流向 Anthropic 而非谷歌；持有或 sell-put 前需重新评估 AI 竞争力定价风险。

items.title: Fed Monetary Policy Report July 2026: Rates held at 3.50-3.75%, forward guidance abandoned; AI capex and Middle East risks cited
items.summary: The Fed's July 2026 MPR reaffirms the federal funds rate at 3.50%-3.75% (unchanged since June). Chair Kevin Warsh says the Fed will no longer provide traditional forward guidance, signaling greater meeting-by-meeting flexibility. The report cites elevated inflation partly from Middle East energy shocks, while noting strong business investment driven by AI data-center construction. Futures markets price rates rising toward ~4% by year-end.
items.why: 联储放弃前瞻指引增加加息不确定性，高 IV 环境整体利好 sell-put 策略；维持高利率对科技成长股估值有压制，但 AI 资本开支强劲叙事不变，英伟达等 AI 基础设施受益逻辑仍成立。

items.title: Intel (INTC) to report Q2 2026 earnings July 23; stock up 160% YTD; analysts eye 18A foundry ramp and $14.4B revenue
items.summary: Intel confirmed Q2 2026 results on July 23 after market close, with earnings call at 2 PM PDT. Analyst consensus: revenue ~$14.4B, EPS ~$0.10 (vs -$0.26 a year ago). Intel has rallied ~160% in 2026 amid AI infrastructure tailwinds. Key focus: 18A manufacturing process progress, AI server share, PC demand durability. Semiconductor sector down ~11% over the past month — sector weakness may create post-earnings noise.
items.why: 本周四（7月23日）是英特尔关键业绩催化剂；今年涨幅160%设置高预期门槛，若指引不及预期叠加半导体弱势，下行风险显著；关注 18A 代工进展是否兑现，若兑现可作为 sell-put 支撑依据。

items.title: 阿里巴巴（9988.HK/BABA）Q1 FY27前瞻大超预期：阿里云收入增速加速至约45%，港股盘中涨超13%
items.summary: 7月8日机构发布阿里巴巴 FY27 Q1（2026年4-6月）前瞻：阿里云季度收入增速加速至约45%（市场预期约30%），EBITA margin从9.1%扩至低双位数；淘宝闪购单季减亏约80亿元；集团整体收入预计同比增约9%。港股当日盘中涨超13%，收涨12.21%至107.5港元。正式 Q1 财报预计8月正式发布。
items.why: 阿里云 45% 增速超预期是最重要信号，AI 云化需求快速落地；若正式财报兑现此预期，将触发港股互联网板块估值重估；当前可评估 sell-put（行权价90-95港元区间有技术支撑）或增加正股配置。
items.source: 新浪财经 / 华尔街见闻

items.title: SanDisk (SNDK) and Kioxia begin 10th-gen BiCS10 NAND production (332 layers, +59% density); SanDisk secures multi-year Meta NAND supply deal
items.summary: SanDisk and Kioxia began producing 10th-generation BiCS10 3D NAND at Kitakami Fab2 (Japan) on July 3. BiCS10 stacks 332 layers, achieves density >29 Gb/mm2 (+59% vs prior gen), interface speed 4.8 Gbps (+33%), and 34% lower output power. SanDisk separately secured a multi-year NAND flash supply deal with Meta for AI infrastructure build-out. The SanDisk-Kioxia JV was extended through 2034. SNDK stock retested $1,500 amid NAND competition concerns.
items.why: BiCS10 量产+Meta 长约强化 SNDK 在 AI 存储市场的竞争地位；NAND vs HBM 资本开支博弈是关键风险，需关注 ASP 走势；NAND 供应商（SNDK/Kioxia/三星）竞争激烈，适合持续跟踪而非激进建仓。

items.title: 美团（3690.HK）即时零售日单量峰值破1.5亿创历史新高；Keeta海外覆盖香港、沙特、科威特、巴西
items.summary: 7月美团披露：即时零售日订单量峰值突破1.5亿单（全量配送平均时效34分钟），刷新历史纪录。Keeta已进驻香港、沙特、阿联酋及科威特，并在巴西采用新运营模式；中东地区已呈现规模效益，单位经济改善明显。另，美团自研大模型 LongCat-2.0（万亿参数，5万卡国产算力集群推理）于7月6日正式全面开源。
items.why: 即时零售破亿单叠加持续减亏，验证美团核心业务护城河；Keeta 国际化扩张是长期增量叙事；结合阿里淘宝闪购减亏加速，两者竞争格局趋于稳定，为 sell-put 提供更确定性支撑。

items.title: Palantir (PLTR) confirms Q2 2026 earnings on Aug 3; analysts forecast $1.8B revenue (+80% YoY), EPS $0.35 (+115% YoY)
items.summary: Palantir confirmed Q2 2026 results August 3 after market close with webcast at 5:00 PM ET. Wall Street projects ~$1.8B revenue (+80% YoY) and EPS of $0.35 (more than double year-ago). Q1 2026 context: US revenue +104% YoY, total revenue +85% YoY; FY 2026 guidance raised to 71% YoY growth. Stock has pulled back with broader tech sector but FY guidance momentum remains intact.
items.why: Palantir 政府+商业 AI 软件双轮驱动，8月3日业绩是下一个关键验证窗口；当前 IV 因板块回调抬升，sell-put（行权价70-80美元区间）可锁定溢价；FY2026指引71%增长若兑现将强化长期持仓逻辑。

items.title: US strikes Iran, oil surges ~16% for the week; Iran sanctions waiver expires July 17 — geopolitical risk premium elevated globally
items.summary: The Trump administration launched fresh strikes on Iran and declined to renew the temporary waiver on Iranian oil sanctions, which expired July 17. Brent crude jumped ~7% on the day of strikes and surged approximately 16% over the week. The Strait of Hormuz remains at risk following attacks on commercial vessels. Higher oil prices stoke inflation concerns globally, complicating the Fed's policy path and contributing to the week's global equity sell-off.
items.why: 油价周内大涨16%叠加中东地缘持续紧张：通胀压力升温可能推迟美联储降息（7月28-29日FOMC是关键节点）；能源股短期受益但科技/消费估值承压；对港股/A股——人民币贬值压力上升，进口成本提高；持有消费类sell put仓位的投资者需适当扩大执行价与现价之间的安全缓冲。

items.title: 华尔街见闻早餐（7月20日）：美股三大指数两连跌抹平7月涨幅，纳指全周跌近3%，半导体指数跌入熊市区间
items.summary: 美国三大股指周五延续跌势，全周抹平7月以来涨幅。费城半导体指数全周跌近10%，正式进入熊市区间；英伟达周五收跌超2%，此前两日累计跌超20%，盘中苹果一度夺回全球个股市值第一位；SK海力士收涨逾1%小幅回稳。中东局势持续，全周原油大涨近16%，美元指数走强，亚太风险情绪承压。
items.why: 美股半导体全周跌入熊市是本周最关键信号：英伟达两日暴跌20%+触发行业估值重估，隐含波动率大幅走高，对持有NVDA相关Sell Put/Covered Call仓位者建议立即检视保证金占用和Delta敞口；油价大涨16%叠加韩国加息，全球利率上行压力可能推迟美联储降息，权益风险溢价收缩空间受限。

items.title: 证监会7月20日召开座谈会促稳市，A股周五大跌：上证跌3.05%失守3800点，创业板暴跌7.15%
items.summary: 7月17日（周五），A股遭遇年内最强系统性下跌，上证指数跌3.05%收报3764.15点，失守3800关键点位并创年内新低；创业板指暴跌7.15%刷新年内最大单日跌幅，科创50跌逾7%，港股AI大模型股智谱跌近30%。外因系韩股与美股半导体抛售蔓延、中东局势持续输入地缘风险；内因系前期科技行情高位获利盘集中释放。证监会随即宣布7月20日召开上市公司、券商及基金座谈会。
items.why: A股年内最强单日跌幅叠加证监会紧急座谈会，政策底信号强烈；持有消费+科技中长期仓位需关注周一开盘企稳与否——若证监会会议传达积极信号，sell put仓位的时间价值有望快速兑现；若跌势延续，建议扩大Delta缓冲，关注3700-3750支撑区间。
items.source: 第一财经 / 新浪财经

items.title: 国新投资等央企动用超500亿元回购增持专项再贷款维稳A股，多家私募宣布自购
items.summary: 国新控股旗下国新投资已动用股票回购增持专项再贷款及配套资金超500亿元维护市场稳定；中国诚通及旗下诚通资本、诚旸投资聚焦国资央企，累计买入A股近百亿元。多家私募机构也宣布自购旗下基金，形成政策托底合力。
items.why: 国家队合计逾600亿资金入场，是近年规模较大的一次集中护盘，若周一（7月20日）低开后承接力强，为sell put仓位提供安全边际；但需注意大规模托底本身也反映市场内生动力不足，中期仍需观察基本面改善。
items.source: 新浪财经 / 第一财经

items.title: Bank of Korea raises rate 25bp to 2.75%, first hike in 3.5 years, signals further tightening as CPI hits 3.2%
items.summary: South Korea's Monetary Policy Board unanimously voted on July 16 to raise its benchmark rate by 25 basis points to 2.75%, the first hike since January 2023. June headline CPI jumped to 3.2% — its highest since 2023 — driven by elevated oil prices and a weaker won. Governor Shin Hyun-song signaled further tightening is possible. South Korea's Ministry of Finance simultaneously raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast from 2.0% to 3.0%, the highest projection in five years.
items.why: 韩国央行在三年半后重启加息周期，全球利率风险偏高叙事进一步强化；韩股（KOSPI）和SK海力士短期受压，传导至港股半导体ETF；整体市场利率上行环境使折现率提高，持有高估值科技股期权仓位需适当扩大安全边际；7月28-29日美联储FOMC为下一个关键节点。

items.title: TSMC Q2 2026 net profit surges 77% YoY to record $22B; raises full-year revenue growth guidance to 40%+; adds $100B Arizona investment
items.summary: TSMC reported record Q2 2026 net profit of $21.99 billion (+77% YoY) on revenue of $40.2 billion, beating consensus EPS of $3.80 with actual $4.31 — its fifth consecutive all-time quarterly profit. TSMC raised full-year 2026 revenue growth guidance from 'over 30%' to 'slightly above 40%'. Simultaneously announced an additional $100 billion Arizona investment, cementing its lead as the exclusive manufacturer of Nvidia Blackwell GPUs and Apple A-series chips.
items.why: 台积电Q2净利创纪录+77%并大幅上调全年指引，AI算力需求强劲确认无疑：利好整个半导体生态（英伟达Blackwell供应无虞，HBM订单逻辑得到背书）；台积电ADR（TSM）作为AI算力代理标的，在当前半导体整体回调中是优质sell put目标，亚利桑那追加1000亿美元凸显长期确定性。

items.title: 财政部联合发文：2026年9月起固态电池、钠离子电池、燃料电池等新型电池免征消费税
items.summary: 财政部、海关总署、税务总局7月20日联合公告，明确自2026年9月1日起分步调整部分电池产品消费税政策：固态电池、钠离子电池、燃料电池及光伏电池中的钙钛矿、叠层、砷化镓电池全部免征消费税，以支持新能源产业转型升级。
items.why: 固态/钠离子电池免消费税直接利好产业链：短期催化宁德时代、比亚迪等A股龙头；也间接支持搭载固态电池路线图的小米汽车SU7 Ultra（1810.HK）以及新能源整车厂商；9月实施留有充足准备窗口，可关注A股新能源板块的结构性机会。
items.source: 四大证券报 / 新浪财经

items.title: Tesla Robotaxi expands to Miami (first unsupervised market outside Texas), fleet at 175 in Texas; Q2 report due July 22
items.summary: Tesla expanded its unsupervised Robotaxi service to Miami — the first deployment outside Texas — with fully autonomous Model Y vehicles covering western/central Miami-Dade. Texas fleet grew to 175 vehicles (up 100+ in one month). Four more cities in preparation. Q2 production: 451,758 vehicles; deliveries: 480,126. Q2 earnings due July 22. TSLA stock was down ~2.3% at ~$382 ahead of the report.
items.why: 特斯拉Robotaxi商业化持续落地（迈阿密为德州外首个无监督市场），是中长期自动驾驶叙事的重要里程碑；当前股价约$382较$420高点回调约9%，Robotaxi扩张进展或提供支撑；Q2财报（7月22日）是近期关键催化剂，关注汽车毛利率和现金流数字；财报前IV偏高，可考虑卖出跨式策略。

items.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) drops ~4% ahead of Q2 earnings July 22; Gemini AI revenue up 8x YoY — Google Cloud backlog at $460B
items.summary: Alphabet fell roughly 4% to ~$346.77 this week as investors took profits before its Q2 2026 earnings report on July 22 after market close. Q1 highlights: Google Cloud revenue +63% YoY; contracted Cloud backlog nearly doubled to ~$460 billion; Gemini AI revenue increased eightfold versus a year ago. Full-year 2026 capex guidance raised to $180-190 billion. Gemini 3.5 Pro launched July 17.
items.why: 谷歌Q2财报将于7月22日（本周二）公布，Gemini AI收入同比增8倍是亮点，但1800-1900亿美元年度capex是最大争议点；股价提前跌4%可能已消化部分悲观预期。持有GOOGL仓位者：财报后观察指引再决策；期权策略可考虑财报后卖出高IV跨式收取时间价值。

items.title: 阿里千问7月15日正式确认接入Apple Intelligence，中国区苹果用户可在系统级直调AI能力
items.summary: 苹果中国区AI功能（Apple Intelligence）完成备案，阿里巴巴通义千问（Qwen）作为核心AI能力提供商接入Apple Intelligence，为iOS、iPadOS、macOS和visionOS中国用户提供文本理解、图像生成和内容创作体验，用户无需切换应用即可在系统级直接调用。消息公布后阿里巴巴盘前涨超4%。
items.why: 千问接入苹果生态是阿里AI商业化的重大里程碑：直接触达中国区数亿苹果设备用户，API调用量预期大幅提升；利好9988.HK/BABA估值重估，是Sell Put策略的优质标的区间。需关注苹果是否纳入其他合作伙伴（如百度），可能稀释独家溢价。

items.title: 美团Keeta持续扩张沙特阿拉伯，海外即时配送业务起飞；多多买菜即将推出即时配送正面竞争
items.summary: 美团外卖海外版Keeta在沙特阿拉伯持续扩大覆盖范围，海外业务进入增长轨道。国内外卖竞争白热化：多多买菜将上线即时配送服务正面叫板美团；美团单日峰值突破1.5亿单，淘宝闪购约8000万单。7月18日市场监管总局已约谈美团、饿了么、京东三平台要求理性竞争。
items.why: 美团Keeta出海是新增长极但规模尚小；国内多多买菜进入即时配送是直接威胁，竞争加剧可能压缩外卖毛利率。监管约谈暗示竞争烈度可能边际降温。持有3690.HK者需关注Q2财报中即时零售毛利率和骑手成本变化数据。

items.title: Futu Holdings Securities Fraud Class Action — CSRC Proposes RMB 1.85B Penalty, Stock Down ~32%
items.summary: 中国证监会拟对富途涉嫌未持牌在大陆经营证券业务处罚约18.5亿元人民币（约2.71亿美元）；FUTU股价已累计下跌约32%，多家律所已对公司提起证券欺诈集体诉讼，截止日期8月25日。
items.why: 监管重罚将严重冲击富途2026年利润预期；若FUTU持有期权仓位，需立即重估估值底部，风险极高。

items.title: 金价半年跌超28%，老铺黄金市值蒸发千亿，实探门店冷清、二手折价
items.summary: 2026年上半年金价累计下跌逾28%，老铺黄金（6181.HK）股价从2025年历史高位1065港元跌至约373港元（跌幅超65%），门店客流下滑明显，部分二手产品已低于零售价流通，品牌热度明显消退。
items.why: 金价下行周期中老铺黄金业绩与估值双杀，对持有6181.HK仓位是重大风险警示；期权卖方需审视行权价与金价走势相关性。

items.title: 腾讯带头：上半年港股回购近千亿港元，7月持续以每周数亿规模回购
items.summary: 腾讯控股上半年累计回购约244亿港元，占港股市场同期回购总量约四分之一；7月3日耗资5.01亿港元、7月6日耗资2.05亿港元，平均每周回购规模达5亿+港元，护盘信号明确。
items.why: 腾讯大规模持续回购给股价提供下行安全垫，sell put持仓者安全边际增厚；高分红+回购双重股东回报吸引中长期持有。

items.title: 上半年经济运行在合理区间 新动能快速成长
items.summary: 国家统计局：中国2026年上半年GDP同比增长4.7%，总量69.6万亿元，为近五年同期最大增量；CPI同比+1.0%，核心CPI +1.2%，城镇调查失业率均值5.2%，就业总体稳定。
items.why: GDP增速符合全年目标，宏观基本面稳定，利好持有消费和科技赛道的港股A股中长期仓位，核心逻辑不变。

items.title: Intel Foundry Snags AMD, NVIDIA, and OpenAI as Design Wins on 18A & 14A Nodes
items.summary: 英特尔宣布18A良品率从65%提升至85%（接近台积电N2制程90%），并获AMD/英伟达/苹果/微软/OpenAI等重量级设计合同；18A-P进入风险量产，性能较18A提升9%或功耗降18%。
items.why: 英特尔代工业务突破性进展，若大客户量产落地将重塑半导体竞争格局；INTC持仓者迎来估值重估关键催化，需关注台积电产能分流影响。

items.title: Tesla Robotaxi Drives into Miami with No Safety Monitor; Q2 Deliveries Top 480K; Earnings July 22
items.summary: 特斯拉Q2交付480,126辆，同比增25%、超预期18%；Robotaxi无安全员首次落地迈阿密（全美第三州）；Q2财报将于7月22日发布，市场预期营收约276亿美元，为TSLA近期最重要事件节点。
items.why: 交付超预期+Robotaxi里程碑双重催化；7月22日财报前波动率溢价值得用covered call锁利，财报后方向则取决于指引。

items.title: Alphabet shares fall on report its most powerful AI model Gemini 3.5 Pro is delayed
items.summary: Bloomberg报道谷歌旗舰AI模型Gemini 3.5 Pro因代码能力未达内部标准而延期数月；GOOGL当日收跌4.4%至354.46美元，市值单日蒸发约2000亿美元。内部工程师担忧公司在AI竞争中落后于Anthropic和OpenAI。
items.why: 谷歌AI竞争力受质疑，对GOOGL估值有持续下行压力；AI大模型赛道格局重整，受益方为OpenAI/Anthropic生态。

items.title: Micron Breaks Ground on Hiroshima Fab Expansion — $9.3B Investment, Japan Subsidy Up to $3.3B
items.summary: 美光7月4日在广岛工厂破土动工，投资1.5万亿日元（约93亿美元），获日本政府补贴最高5000亿日元（约33亿美元）；聚焦1γ DRAM和HBM产能扩充，设备安装预计2028年下半年启动。
items.why: 美光产能规划积极，HBM4已开始交付英伟达Vera Rubin平台；长期产能扩张或平衡HBM溢价，近期MU 2026年HBM已售罄定价优势仍在。

items.title: Nvidia pitches Vera CPU to Chinese clients, August delivery target as H200 sales stall
items.summary: 英伟达向中国客户推介Vera CPU芯片（88核Arm架构，专为AI推理工作负载设计），目标8月交货；中国云厂商有兴趣但暂时仅计划在海外数据中心测试部署；H200对华出口实际已停滞。
items.why: 英伟达通过CPU渠道重开中国市场销售，对NVDA中国营收有一定补充；但CPU产品与GPU性能差距大，对AI算力格局影响有限。

items.title: GENIUS Act Stablecoin Final Rules Deadline July 18: Six Agencies Finalize Framework, USDC Positioned as Compliant Benchmark
items.summary: GENIUS Act规定6个联邦监管机构须于7月18日前发布稳定币最终规则；Circle/USDC已实质合规并申请PPSI指定；法规核心约束：合规稳定币禁止向持有人付息，FDIC要求2个工作日内完成美元赎回。
items.why: GENIUS Act落地明确稳定币合规框架，Circle/USDC受益先发优势；对CRCL中长期估值正面，监管靴子落地降低不确定性风险。

items.title: US June CPI Cools Sharply: Core MoM Flat, Fed July Hike Odds Collapse to 17%
items.summary: June headline CPI fell 0.1% MoM (+3.5% YoY); core CPI was flat 0% MoM vs 0.2% expected. Treasury yields slid sharply. Markets price only 17% probability of a Fed hike at the July 29 FOMC meeting vs 42% the prior day.
items.why: 通胀超预期降温是港股/美股本周反弹的核心驱动；若7月29日FOMC按兵不动，成长股估值支撑进一步夯实，期权卖方偏有利。

items.title: US Revokes Iran Oil Waiver After Hormuz Attacks; Brent Rebounds Above $76
items.summary: The US revoked Iran's temporary oil export waiver (valid to Aug 21) after attacks on three commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude rebounded over 3% to ~$76.48/bbl. Iran threatened decisive actions. Sanctions now bar Iranian oil transactions effective July 17.
items.why: 油价反弹压通胀预期，可能推迟美联储降息时间表；地缘风险上升对全球风险资产构成阻力，卖出期权需注意波动率抬升风险。

items.title: China Q2 GDP Misses 5% Target at 4.3% — Weakest Growth in Over 3 Years
items.summary: China's Q2 2026 GDP expanded 4.3% YoY, missing both the 4.5% consensus and the government's ~5% target — first miss since pre-pandemic. H1 GDP was 4.7%. Urban fixed-asset investment fell 5.7% H1; retail sales rebounded 1% in June after -0.6% in May.
items.why: GDP增速低于目标强化市场对刺激政策的押注，但内需疲软对消费类持仓（美团、携程、海底捞）构成基本面压力，需跟踪政策响应。

items.title: 港股恒指7月18日涨1.3%至25009点，科技消费股集体拉升
items.summary: 受美国6月CPI超预期降温提振，港股恒指7月18日上涨约1.3%收报25,009点。持仓个股全面走强：腾讯+2.1%、美团+4.9%、小米+6.2%、泡泡玛特+6.9%、快手+5.6%。
items.why: 持仓港股集体拉升，卖出期权delta风险下降；美联储加息预期持续回落有利估值修复，中期偏多。

items.title: 金价半年跌超28%，老铺黄金市值较高点蒸发逾1200亿港元，估值回落至12倍PE
items.summary: 国际金价较年初高点下跌超28%，老铺黄金（6181.HK）市值较历史峰值蒸发逾1200亿港元。记者实探显示多地门店客流稀疏，二手市场折价，部分门店已上架按克重计价产品；估值从约50倍PE跌至约12倍，已接近周大福、老凤祥等传统金店水平。
items.why: 金价大幅下行重塑老铺估值逻辑，东方硬奢溢价模式遭严峻考验；若有卖出期权敞口需评估下行风险，或考虑调低行权价。

items.title: Tesla Robotaxi Goes Fully Unsupervised in Miami — Now Live in 4 Cities With No Safety Driver
items.summary: Tesla's fully unsupervised Model Y Robotaxi expanded to Miami on July 16, joining Austin, Dallas and Houston. No driver or safety monitor inside. The Miami service area covers western/central Miami-Dade. Waymo operates in 5 states vs Tesla's 2 states and 4 markets.
items.why: Robotaxi持续商业落地兑现马斯克自动驾驶估值叙事；每新增城市提升确信度，利好TSLA中期持仓；财报前（7月22日）Robotaxi进展或进一步压缩隐波下行空间。

items.title: 京东AI Agent与腾讯元宝打通小程序生态，混元Hy3日均Token消耗量较前代20倍
items.summary: 7月15日，京东AI Agent与腾讯元宝完成小程序生态集成，支持购物推荐、售后等场景。腾讯7月6日已正式发布混元Hy3，日均Token消耗量较前代20倍；微信AI Agent小薇灰测中，依托14亿月活用户与百万级小程序生态。
items.why: 元宝生态扩张与微信Agent落地是腾讯 AI从研发向变现转化的早期信号，巩固0700.HK中长期持仓逻辑；Sell put存续期内基本面改善中。

items.title: Futu Holdings: CSRC proposes ~RMB1.85B penalty for unlicensed mainland China brokerage; US class actions filed
items.summary: On May 22, 2026, China's CSRC issued Futu Holdings a penalty pre-notification: confiscation of ~RMB470M illegal gains + RMB1.38B fine (total ~RMB1.85B) for conducting regulated brokerage activities without required mainland China licenses. Multiple US securities class action lawsuits were subsequently filed against Futu and its executives covering the period May 2023-May 2026.
items.why: 富途（FUTU）是持仓标的；合计处罚约超一年净利润，叠加集体诉讼，短期估值受压；建议降低行权价保护，并重新评估是否维持仓位。

items.title: 长鑫科技7月16日开启科创板申购，拟募资295亿元，为2026年A股最大IPO
items.summary: 国产DRAM龙头长鑫科技（证券代码688825）于7月16日正式开启新股申购，拟募资295亿元，为科创板历史第二大IPO（仅次于中芯国际），也是2026年A股最大IPO。公司为中国第一、全球第四的DRAM厂商，估值超4万亿元。7月20日缴款截止，预计近期上市。
items.why: 国产存储芯片破局里程碑，短期带动半导体打新行情；长鑫上市将重塑DRAM供给格局，影响美光（MU）、SK海力士的竞争格局，值得密切跟踪。

items.title: 中国Q2 GDP同比增长4.3%，低于预期目标下限，为2022年Q4以来最弱
items.summary: 国家统计局7月15日公布，2026年Q2 GDP同比增长4.3%，低于4.5%市场共识，远低于Q1的5.0%，首次跌破政府4.5%-5.0%目标区间下限。H1累计增速4.7%，出口Q2大增27%，但内需持续疲软，K型分化加剧。
items.why: GDP首次跌破目标下限，逆周期政策发力预期升温，有利消费/互联网板块估值修复；短期不确定性加大，卖put需关注波动率提升。

items.title: 人民银行：加大逆周期和跨周期调节力度，着力扩大内需
items.summary: 7月15日，央行发表声明，将继续实施适度宽松货币政策，加大逆周期和跨周期调节力度，巩固拓展经济稳中向好势头，重点着力扩大内需、优化供给。此举直接回应Q2 GDP低于目标区间下限的数据压力。
items.why: 央行明确加码宽松信号，利于消费与科技港股估值抬升；宽松预期下sell put策略（美团、腾讯、阿里等标的）的权利金保护进一步丰厚。

items.title: 习近平出席2026世界人工智能大会并发表主旨讲话，宣布成立全球AI合作组织
items.summary: 7月17日，习近平在上海出席WAIC 2026开幕式，宣布成立世界人工智能合作组织，承诺5年内向发展中国家提供5000个AI培训名额；国家发改委同步发布AI合作发展行动计划。大会7月17-20日举行，逾1000家企业参展。
items.why: 国家最高层为AI产业背书，直接利好腾讯（元宝/混元）、阿里（通义）等AI布局的港股/A股核心持仓，也强化AI赛道中长期配置逻辑。

items.title: Gold slips below $4,000 despite US-Iran strikes; Strait of Hormuz closure drives oil higher, raises rate-hike fears
items.summary: XAU/USD fell below $4,000 on July 17 after briefly reaching $4,015 on July 14. US strikes on Iran and Iran's threatened Strait of Hormuz closure pushed oil sharply higher — paradoxically bearish for gold as higher oil raises inflation expectations and potential Fed tightening, overriding the traditional safe-haven bid.
items.why: 金价下行对老铺黄金（6181.HK）情绪偏负；美伊冲突加大全球市场波动率，科技/半导体持仓的期权IV也因此走高，短期卖put需留意保护。

items.title: Apple surpasses Nvidia as most valuable US company; Nvidia -3.5%+ as AI chip selloff spreads to Asia
items.summary: Apple overtook Nvidia to become the most valuable US company by market cap as Apple gained ~0.3% while Nvidia dropped more than 3.5% on July 17-18. Asian semiconductor stocks extended the selloff — HSI down 0.8%, CSI 300 -1.64% — on growing concerns about AI capex sustainability. Nvidia has fallen ~10.8% in June; next earnings are late August.
items.why: 英伟达（NVDA）持仓在AI算力担忧下回调，短期波动率高；Apple取代Nvidia市值王座是里程碑，反映市场对AI算力泡沫的再评价；sell put需适当下移行权价保护。

items.title: Alphabet reports Q2 2026 on July 22; Google Cloud 63% growth expected; Gemini 3.5 Pro delay hit stock -4%
items.summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) reports Q2 2026 after US close on July 22 (earnings call 4:30am HKT July 23). Q1 2026: revenue $109.9B (+22% YoY), Google Cloud $20B (+63%), record backlog $462B, operating margin 36.1%. Gemini 3.5 Pro launch postponed after poor internal benchmarks, causing stock to slide ~4%. Street expects continued Cloud acceleration.
items.why: 谷歌（GOOGL）是持仓标的；财报前IV高企，是滚动covered call的时间窗口；Gemini延期显示AI竞争加剧，Cloud超高增速是核心看点，Q2数据将决定下一阶段走势。

items.title: Trip.com Q1 2026: Revenue +17% to RMB16.2B; international OTA +65%; inbound travel bookings +90% YoY
items.summary: Trip.com Group (TCOM/9961.HK) Q1 2026: total net revenues RMB16.2B (US$2.4B), +17% YoY. International OTA platform gross bookings +65% YoY; inbound travel bookings surged ~90% YoY. International business is now 40% of total revenue. Q2 2026 guidance: EPS $1.15, revenue ~$2.50B. Goal: serve 200M inbound travelers over 5 years.
items.why: 携程（TCOM/9961.HK）是持仓标的；入境游+65%-90%爆发性增长远超预期，出海战略实质推进中，有力支撑估值提升；旅游消费板块与消费赛道逻辑共振。

items.title: SanDisk (SNDK) +857% in H1 2026 on NAND surge; -15% in July chip selloff; Goldman raises target to $2,200
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) stock skyrocketed 857% in H1 2026 driven by a structural NAND flash shortage fuelled by AI infrastructure demand. Shares fell ~15% on July 15 in the broader chip selloff. Goldman Sachs raised price target to $2,200 (Buy) on July 5 citing supply tightness. Fiscal Q4 2026 earnings due August 5.
items.why: SanDisk（SNDK）是闪存/存储持仓，H1大涨后7月回调属正常整理；NAND供给持续紧张，Goldman看好，F4财报前是sell put窗口；回调幅度需关注，防止行权。

items.title: 长鑫科技IPO：华尔街加密合约疯炒、估值从5792亿飙至4万亿，散户212倍超额认购
items.summary: 长鑫科技（CXMT）7月16日以8.66元/股开启申购，募资逾579亿元，若行使绿鞋可达666亿元，成科创板第二大IPO；散户认购倍数212倍，加密合约盘前隐含估值一度达3.9万亿元，308倍PE引发争议。
items.why: CXMT上市将重塑A股存储赛道格局，其DRAM量产能力直接威胁SK海力士HBM主导地位；同时体量庞大的新股冻结效应已压制指数短线走势，对卖出put策略需警惕波动率突然放大。

items.title: 金价半年跌超28%，老铺黄金市值蒸发千亿：门店客流冷清、二手折价、按克金上架
items.summary: 新浪7月18日实地探访老铺黄金（6181.HK）门店，发现客流明显减少，二手市场出现较大折价，部分门店开始按克定价销售，股价当日跌逾4.6%。自2025年7月高点（1102港元）至今跌幅超65%，市值蒸发逾千亿港元。
items.why: 金价深度回调正在侵蚀老铺黄金的品牌溢价逻辑；门店客流恶化是先行指标，预示下季收入或进一步承压；持仓者需评估是否调整行权价或行权时机。

items.title: Circle wins OCC national bank charter (First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A.) — stock rallied ~5%
items.summary: Circle received final approval from the OCC to operate First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A., a national trust bank. The regulatory milestone sent CRCL shares up approximately 5% on the news day and validates Circle's long-term strategy to embed USDC into the regulated banking system.
items.why: 银行牌照批准是Circle发展史上里程碑事件，显著提升USDC合规可信度；与今日GENIUS Act截止日共同构成Circle的关键监管周——短线波动可能较大，需监控期权IV。

items.title: Kimi K3 (2.8T-parameter) launch triggers DeepSeek flashback: Nvidia -2% premarket, semiconductor ETF -20%+ from June high
items.summary: Moonshot AI (Alibaba-backed) released Kimi K3 on July 18 — a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight model beating Claude Fable 5 on Frontend Code Arena — causing Nvidia to fall ~2% premarket and the VanEck Semiconductor ETF to extend its decline to more than 20% below its late-June record. Analysts split: Patrick Moorhead called it 'an over-reaction shockingly similar to DeepSeek panic.'
items.why: 中国AI高效模型冲击重演——影响英伟达GPU需求预期，同时利好阿里巴巴/月之暗面在AI基础设施叙事上的估值；对持有NVDA卖put头寸需关注隐含波动率（IV）短线上行风险。

items.title: 长鑫科技IPO申购抽干A股流动性，上证指数大跌3.05%创近11月低点
items.summary: A股7月17日重挫：上证综指跌3.05%至3764点，创近11个月新低；深证成指跌5.4%。科创板史上最大IPO长鑫科技（CXMT）申购冻结巨量资金，叠加宇树科技、长鑫存储等超大型上市排队，引发市场恐慌性抛售，半导体板块领跌。
items.why: A股大幅调整影响港股及中概整体情绪；CXMT IPO为存储赛道重大事件，直接牵动SK海力士、美光对标估值；若持有A股科技仓位需警惕短线回撤。

items.title: Pop Mart surges 6.9% on World Cup MEGA LABUBU 400% edition launch (HK$1,625/unit, 1 per person)
items.summary: Pop Mart (9992.HK) introduced the 'MEGA LABUBU 400% World Cup 26' figure at HK$1,625, strictly limited to one per person. The limited-edition collab drove a single-day stock jump of approximately 6.9%, highlighting Labubu's continued monetization power as a flagship IP.
items.why: 联名限定款验证Labubu IP持续吸金能力，为即将公布的业绩提供正向预期修正；段永平三度增持背书价值逻辑，对持仓者信号偏正。

items.title: Intel 18A-P moves to risk production; foundry yield rises to 85%; Nvidia and OpenAI among confirmed customers
items.summary: Intel Foundry announced that Intel 18A-P (the performance-enhanced variant of 18A) has entered risk production on schedule. Foundry yield has improved from 65% to 85%, and Intel has secured orders from Nvidia, AMD, Marvell, Microsoft, Micron, and OpenAI. The process node offers up to 9% higher performance or 18% lower power versus base 18A.
items.why: 18A良率大幅提升并获Nvidia/OpenAI订单，是英特尔代工转型最重要的正面信号；若商业良率如期于2026年末达标，将显著改善代工业务亏损局面，有助于股价修复。

items.title: SanDisk SNDK: Goldman raises target to $2,200; Motley Fool projects $3,000 by year-end; NAND supply tight into 2027
items.summary: Goldman Sachs raised its SanDisk (SNDK) price target to $2,200 (from $1,200) on July 5, citing continued NAND supply tightness. The Motley Fool (July 15) projected $3,000 by year-end. SanDisk has surged ~4,885% since its February 2025 Nasdaq debut. Q4 FY2026 earnings are due August 5.
items.why: NAND价格持续紧张叠加分析师目标价大幅上调，对持有SNDK仓位的投资者是正向信号；8月5日财报为下一关键催化点，可考虑在财报前布局sell put以赚取时间价值。

items.title: Disney 'Moana' live-action misfires with $43M U.S. opening — down 38% vs. prior weekend market
items.summary: Disney's live-action 'Moana' remake opened to just $43M domestically, significantly underperforming expectations as the entire marketplace was down 38% from the prior weekend. The result raises questions about Disney's live-action remake strategy and franchise monetization.
items.why: Moana开局不佳令市场对迪士尼票房回升预期降温；迪士尼内容+流媒体商业模式受质疑，短线股价承压；对DIS持仓者需关注管理层是否下调内容指引。

items.title: Meituan earnings call: Keeta Saudi Arabia nearing month-1 profitability; Q1 2026 revenue CNY91B (+5.6%), net loss CNY6.8B
items.summary: Meituan's earnings call highlighted that Keeta's Saudi Arabia operations are expected to achieve profitability within their first full month of operation. Q1 2026 saw revenue rise 5.6% YoY to CNY91B, but a net swing to a CNY6.8B loss (vs. CNY10.1B profit a year ago) due to intensified competition and overseas spending. Full-year new-business losses expected below 2025 levels.
items.why: Keeta出海盈利节点提前是重要积极信号——验证海外扩张可行性，有助于收窄估值折价；国内业务竞争激烈仍是短期压力，关注下一季Keeta利润数据改善节奏。

items.title: Gold pulls back to ~$4,016, down ~28% from January all-time high of $5,595
items.summary: Gold has declined sharply from its January 2026 record high, driven by hawkish Fed signals (~60% odds of a September rate hike) and elevated energy prices from Middle East tensions. Goldman Sachs year-end target remains $4,900; JPMorgan's Q4 target is $4,500.
items.why: 金价大幅回调直接影响老铺黄金（6181.HK）和黄金珠宝板块估值；持有相关仓位需重新审视支撑；sell put策略下行风险加大。

items.title: DeepSeek developing in-house AI chip for inference workloads, reducing reliance on Nvidia GPUs
items.summary: Reports indicate DeepSeek is designing its own semiconductor focused on inference workloads — a move that could reduce dependency on Nvidia hardware. The chip is still in development and would primarily serve DeepSeek's own inference needs at scale.
items.why: DeepSeek自研芯片若成真，长期削弱Nvidia在中国推理市场的需求；配合Kimi K3冲击，中国AI自给自足叙事持续强化，对NVDA的中国收入预期构成下行压力。

items.title: 金价H1暴跌逾28%，老铺黄金市值蒸发千亿：门店客流稀疏、存货超160亿元，东方奢品遇严峻考验
items.summary: 每经网今日报道，伦敦现货黄金从年初5598美元/盎司高位急跌，6月底失守4000美元，H1跌幅逾28%；7月17日报3985美元，本周跌逾3%。老铺黄金(6181.HK)股价从高点1065港元已跌逾65%，市值蒸发超1200亿港元。受买涨不买跌心理蔓延，门店客流稀疏；截至2025年底存货超160亿元（同比增近三倍），经营性现金流净流出68亿元。
items.why: 老铺黄金今日直接利空：金价在4000美元以下震荡，门店客流不振，存货高企+现金流为负；若美联储7月28日加息（概率46.5%）→美元进一步走强→金价再度承压，老铺黄金面临业绩+股价双重压力；持有6181.HK sell put仓位的投资者需谨慎调整行权价，建议加宽安全边际或考虑平仓。

items.title: China Q2 2026 GDP Slows to 4.3%, Weakest Since Q4 2022 — Misses 4.5% Target for First Time Since Pandemic
items.summary: China's NBS reported Q2 2026 GDP growth of 4.3% YoY (vs. 4.5% consensus, 5.0% in Q1) — the weakest since Q4 2022 and the first miss of the official target range since the pandemic era. H1 cumulative GDP +4.7%, still inside Beijing's 4.5%-5% band. Urban fixed-asset investment -5.7% H1; June retail sales +1%; industrial output +5.3%. IMF raised China 2026 forecast to 4.6% on high-tech export strength.
items.why: 中国Q2 GDP降至4.3%，内需不振+地产下行是主要拖累，为2022年Q4以来最弱。对港股消费+互联网板块（腾讯、阿里、美团、携程、泡泡玛特）构成阶段性压力；政策层面预计将加码刺激，A股短期有政策支撑预期，但需等待具体落地。持有消费赛道sell put仓位的投资者宜适当加宽安全边际。

items.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Falls 4.4%, Loses ~$200B Market Cap as Gemini 3.5 Pro Reported Months Behind Schedule
items.summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) fell ~4.4% on July 16-17, erasing ~$200B in market cap, after Bloomberg reported Google is months behind on Gemini 3.5 Pro — its most powerful model — due to challenges in improving coding capabilities. The delay compounds the same-day EU antitrust order requiring Android/search data sharing with OpenAI.
items.why: Gemini 3.5 Pro延期+欧盟监管双重打击，谷歌单日跌4.4%；对谷歌sell put持有者需检查当前行权价安全缓冲；模型延期可能使谷歌在AI竞争中短期落后，有利于Palantir/微软/亚马逊的相对估值；建议下个季度财报前重新评估GOOGL仓位敞口。

items.title: US-Iran War Re-escalates: Strait of Hormuz Effectively Closed, Naval Blockade Reinstated, Brent Near $84/Barrel
items.summary: US-Iran ceasefire collapsed July 8 after renewed attacks. The US reimposed a naval blockade, struck Iran's coastal defenses; Iran declared the Strait of Hormuz closed again. Brent crude near $84/barrel; WTI ~$79. The IEA described this as the 'largest supply disruption in the history of the global oil market' — ~25% of global seaborne oil trade transits the Strait. Trump announced a 20% toll on cargo transiting the waterway.
items.why: 霍尔木兹海峡实质封锁+IEA史上最大石油供应中断，Brent原油逼近$84/桶是本周全球市场核心宏观风险：油价上涨→通胀预期↑→美联储7月加息概率46.5%↑→权益估值承压；能源成本上升波及航运和消费品供应链；地缘事件推动短期波动率放大，持有全球名单的sell put投资者需整体加宽安全边际。

items.title: 段永平再度增持泡泡玛特持股升至7.65%成第二大股东，2026年内三度加仓合计逾118亿港元
items.summary: 港交所7月10日权益披露：段永平于7月6日增持泡泡玛特(9992.HK)约1059万股，耗资约15.89亿港元，持股比例从6.85%升至7.65%，成仅次于创始人王宁的第二大股东（总持仓逾153亿港元）。段永平表示公司当前市值约200亿港元，去年净利131亿元，认为未来10-20年平均利润不低于现在。此为其2026年内第三次大规模加仓。
items.why: 段永平三次举牌+合计逾118亿港元，释放明确的价值底部背书信号；但Labubu新系列同期出现破发，市场对单一IP依赖的结构性风险仍有顾虑；对持有9992.HK仓位的投资者：大股东逆势增持减少极端下行风险，是中长期持仓的正向信号，短期需关注新IP销售数据印证。
items.source: 证券时报（港交所权益披露，2026-07-10）

items.title: Tesla FSD v14.3.5 Rolls Out July 13 With Camera Preview; Steering-Wheel-Free Cybercab Begins Public Road Tests in Austin
items.summary: Tesla began rolling out FSD v14.3.5 (firmware 2026.20.6.6) July 13, adding live camera preview (8-9 feeds) for supervised FSD users. Tesla's steering-wheel-less Cybercab robotaxi began engineering tests on Austin public roads. Miami Robotaxi service (launched July 14) is expanding gradually; Phoenix, Tampa, Las Vegas expansions expected by year-end. Q2 2026: 480,000 vehicles delivered, 452,000 produced.
items.why: FSD v14.3.5迭代+Cybercab无人驾驶公路测试，Robotaxi商业化进程持续推进；近期TSLA股价在$420附近，对持有TSLA sell put仓位者利好事件密集、安全垫较充裕；需关注7月28日FOMC结果，加息预期可能短暂压制成长股估值。

items.title: Intel Foundry 18A Yield Reportedly Rises to 85%; Secures Design Orders From Nvidia, OpenAI, AMD and Microsoft
items.summary: Analyst reports indicate Intel's 18A process yield improved from ~65% to 85% — a key threshold for commercial viability. Intel secured design orders from Nvidia, OpenAI, AMD and Microsoft for 18A-based products, building on the 18A-P risk production milestone. Profitable commercial production projected for late 2026/2027. Intel stock had crashed ~21% in a seven-day selloff around July 7-8 on yield and competition concerns.
items.why: 英特尔代工18A良率据报从65%升至85%，并获Nvidia/OpenAI/AMD/Microsoft设计订单，是代工业务拐点最实质性进展；若数据属实+客户首款流片成功，INTC估值重估可能触发；但目前来源系分析师报告而非Intel官方，且距盈利性量产尚需时间；7月初-21%的暴跌仍需消化，建议中线布局。

items.title: Tencent Tests WeChat AI Assistant 'Xiaowei' for 1.4B Users; Q3 Full Rollout Targeted Using WeLM + DeepSeek Hybrid
items.summary: Tencent began limited testing of Xiaowei, a native AI assistant built into WeChat/Weixin, confirmed by official channels June 20. Users interact via text or voice: send messages, hail rides, order food, book services, generate images. The underlying model is WeLM (WeChat's proprietary LLM) with DeepSeek for certain tasks. Full rollout targeted Q3 2026. WeChat/Weixin has 1.4B+ monthly active users.
items.why: 微信小薇AI助手Q3将面向14亿月活用户全量推送，是腾讯AI商业化最大分发渠道；对0700.HK，AI助手落地验证微信超级App在AI时代的护城河，中长线利好持续；近期股价有所回落，Q3全量推出前可关注补仓机会，期权策略可在股价整理期适当卖出看跌期权获取时间价值。
items.source: FintechNews HK / Bloomberg (June 22, 2026) / The Next Web

items.title: SK海力士纳斯达克IPO首日涨13%至168美元，筹资265亿美元创外国公司赴美上市历史纪录
items.summary: SK海力士7月10日以149美元/股在纳斯达克IPO，首日收报168.01美元（+13%），总募资265亿美元（出售1.779亿ADS）超越阿里巴巴2014年的250亿记录；常规交易7月13日起以永久代码SKHY开盘，当日一度回落逾6%；公司是HBM市场领头羊，约50-55%市占率，为英伟达Blackwell/Rubin系列最大供应商。
items.why: SK海力士是持仓标的（港股CSOP两倍做多ETF相关）；纳斯达克上市提升流动性与国际曝光，HBM4E送样叠加SKHY挂牌，短期可能对港股相关ETF产品带来活跃交易机会。

items.title: 美国稳定币法GENIUS Act监管框架7月18日正式生效；Circle同步获批全国信托银行牌照
items.summary: 2025年7月18日签署的GENIUS Act进入合规实施阶段，一年过渡期今日届满，联邦层面稳定币全面监管框架正式生效（涵盖储备要求、披露规则、发行人牌照与持有人保护）；Circle同期获OCC批准开设First National Digital Currency Bank，USDC进一步确立机构级合规地位；美联储新稳定币监管规则同步出台。
items.why: Circle/CRCL是持仓标的；今日是关键监管事件落地日，短期可能引发CRCL股价波动（合规确定性VS新资本要求）；长期监管明确利好USDC机构采用规模化。

items.title: 小米YU7正式发布起售价25.35万元，雷军宣布新一代SU7销量夺冠，2027年进军欧洲
items.summary: 小米正式发布YU7车型，起售价253,500元；7月购车权益：YU7享科技舒享套装限时优惠6500元，YU7 GT综合权益最高7.9万元，SU7 Ultra提供5年0息融资，活动持续至7月31日；雷军宣布新一代SU7销量居细分市场第一，小米汽车计划2027年进入欧洲市场。
items.why: 1810.HK是核心持仓；YU7定价25.35万超出部分市场预期，有助于提振毛利率预期；雷军的欧洲2027声明是里程碑式出海叙事，可能带来短期估值溢价。

items.title: Bloomberg：谷歌Gemini 3.5 Pro发布滞后数月，Alphabet股价7月17日跌约4.4%，市值蒸发约2000亿美元
items.summary: Bloomberg报道谷歌旗舰AI模型Gemini 3.5 Pro的发布进度较原定时间落后数月，引发市场对Google AI竞争力的担忧；Alphabet股价7月17日下跌约4.4%-4.5%，单日市值缩水约2000亿美元；此前已面临搜索反垄断上诉及版权诉讼双重压力。
items.why: GOOGL是持仓标的；Gemini延迟加剧与OpenAI/Anthropic的AI差距感知，搜索广告业务护城河受到质疑；短期情绪压制股价，可关注covered call的权利金收益机会。

items.title: SOX半导体指数7月17日跌4.3%收11876，距高位回落19%，全球芯片股市值蒸发3.3万亿美元
items.summary: 费城半导体指数（SOX）7月17日下跌4.3%至11876.50点，自6月22日历史高点已累计下跌19%，仅差1个百分点即触及熊市定义；全球半导体股市值累计蒸发约3.3万亿美元，30只成分股全部下跌，资金大规模轮动至金融、能源和工业板块。
items.why: 持仓含英伟达、SK海力士、美光、Intel等半导体核心标的，板块系统性下行直接压制持仓市值；sell put策略需重新评估下行保护位。

items.title: 中际旭创通过港交所上市聆讯，拟募资约70亿美元，或成2026年港股最大IPO
items.summary: AI光模块龙头中际旭创7月17日通过港交所上市聆讯，路演后募资目标从50亿上调至约70亿美元（约546亿港元），或超越立讯精密成今年港股最大规模IPO；中金、广发、高盛为联席保荐人。公司800G光模块全球市占超40%，为英伟达最大光模块供应商；Q1 2026营收194.96亿元（+192% YoY）、净利57.35亿元（+262% YoY）。
items.why: 中际旭创是AI算力基础设施核心供应商，其成功上市将进一步增强港股科技板块吸引力，对腾讯、科技板块整体具有正向催化；也为AI供应链估值提供新参照。

items.title: 港股7月17日全线下挫：恒生指数跌1.78%至24562，恒生科技指数跌4.37%
items.summary: 7月17日（周五）恒生指数收报24562.24点，下跌446.36点（-1.78%）；恒生科技指数单日跌4.37%，科技板块成最大重灾区，背景为全球半导体股连续大幅下跌。指数已连续两日回调，16日曾涨2%至25174.79点。
items.why: 港股科技板块集中承压，对持仓腾讯、美团、小米、泡泡玛特等权重港股构成直接拖累；4%以上的单日科技指数跌幅可能触发期权Delta对冲需求上升。

items.title: 美光（MU）7月15日跌约7%：中国CXMT拟85亿美元IPO扩大DRAM产能，叠加HBM出口管制传言
items.summary: 中国存储芯片厂商CXMT宣布拟在国内筹募85亿美元IPO以扩大DRAM生产，引发竞争格局担忧；同时市场传出美政府可能对HBM产品实施新出口管制，两项利空叠加导致Micron（MU）7月15日大跌约7%；KeyBanc随后将目标价从1600上调至1750美元，认为存储市场紧缩将持续至2027年。
items.why: MU是持仓标的；CXMT扩产是中长期供给侧不确定性，HBM出口管制若落地将直接影响MU高毛利段的销售预期；7%单日跌幅值得关注sell put的保护性调整需求。

items.title: Intel 18A制程良率升至85%，斩获英伟达/AMD/OpenAI设计导入，18A-P进入风险量产，股价+4.5%
items.summary: 英特尔7月15日公布18A制程良率已达85%（接近台积电N2的90%，大幅领先三星SF2约55%），正式宣布获得AMD、英伟达、Marvell、微软、Micron、OpenAI等重要代工客户设计导入；18A-P（性能增强版）进入风险量产，同功耗下性能提升9%或同性能下功耗降低18%；INTC当日收涨4.5%（此前月内因18A良率问题曾大跌21%）。
items.why: INTC是持仓标的；18A良率突破85%是Foundry业务存亡的关键里程碑，大客户设计导入（尤其英伟达）可能带来中长期代工收入；建议持续跟踪18A量产节奏。

items.title: 小米规划增程SUV新系列「澎程SkyNomad」，拟推五座与七座两款车型
items.summary: 据报道，小米汽车计划推出全新增程式SUV系列「SkyNomad 小米澎程」，以区别于SU7/YU7的纯电驾驶定位；澎程系列初步规划推出五人座和七人座两款车型，拓展家用大空间赛道，预计进一步扩大小米汽车的目标客群。
items.why: 增程赛道在国内增长迅速，小米切入此赛道将进一步拓宽汽车业务规模；中长期对1810.HK营收和估值具有积极意义。

items.title: 美国AI芯片出口管制6月全面升级，中国企业境外子公司采购英伟达/AMD先进芯片须申请许可
items.summary: 2026年6月，美国BIS发布新指引明确：向中国大陆/澳门注册实体及其境外母公司控制的海外子公司出口先进AI芯片，均须申请许可证，堵塞此前存在近一年的监管漏洞；同期美众议院通过法案禁止中国企业通过云计算远程调用美国AI算力；中国加速推进华为昇腾、寒武纪等国产替代路线。
items.why: 对英伟达（NVDA）、AMD的中国市场营收产生直接负面影响；对腾讯、阿里等AI基础设施扩张形成约束；利好国内AI芯片替代路线相关A股标的。
items.source: VOA中文 / 新浪财经 / 安全内参

items.title: 英伟达FY2026全年营收2159亿美元（+65%），数据中心占比91%，远期PE约23倍创近7年最低
items.summary: 英伟达FY2026全年营收2159.4亿美元（同比+65%），其中数据中心1940亿美元（+75%），占总营收约91%；当前市值约4.7万亿美元，远期PE约23倍（历史5年均值约72倍），估值罕见低位表明盈利增速持续超越股价涨幅；Rubin架构预计提前约两季推出；公司获得客户确认的AI芯片需求承诺超1万亿美元（至2027年）。
items.why: NVDA是持仓标的；超低远期PE与千亿级别订单确认为逢低策略提供估值支撑，结合当前SOX板块系统性下跌，或为sell put/逢低买入期权策略提供较好时机窗口。

items.title: AI Memory Chip Stocks Tumble: SK Hynix -13%, SanDisk -12%, Micron -5% as CXMT IPO Looms
items.summary: SK Hynix fell 11.5% in Seoul and ~13% in US premarket; SanDisk (SNDK) sank 12%; Micron (MU) fell 5%+ as China's CXMT 295B-yuan STAR Market IPO spooks investors. Memory stocks have dropped 20%+ from recent highs, entering a technical bear market despite TSMC's strong results.
items.why: 存储芯片股进入技术性熊市，SK海力士(7709.HK)、美光(MU)直接持仓受损；CXMT上市后竞争格局压力是主要叙事，期权隐含波动率显著上升

items.title: TSMC Q2 2026: Record Revenue $40.2B (+33.7% YoY), AI/HPC Now 66% of Sales, N2 Ramp on Track
items.summary: TSMC Q2 revenue reached $40.2B (top of $39-40.2B guidance), up 33.7% YoY, driven by surging AI demand. HPC platform grew to 66% of revenue. N2 technology ramping; additional N3 capacity investments in Taiwan, Arizona, and Japan. Strong Q3 outlook issued.
items.why: 台积电强劲业绩验证AI芯片需求持续旺盛，但未能阻止存储股下跌说明资金正从存储切向先进制程；英伟达AI算力供应链逻辑获强化

items.title: Netflix Q2 2026 Earnings: Revenue Slight Miss, Weak Q3 Outlook Send Shares Down 8%+
items.summary: Netflix Q2 revenue $12.6B grew 13% YoY but slightly missed consensus; Q3 revenue growth guided at 12% (deceleration). Shares tumbled 8%+ after-hours on growth slowdown concerns. Full-year 2026 guidance narrowed to $51-51.4B.
items.why: 流媒体龙头增长减速，Q3指引低于预期触发估值重估，高IV环境对科技股期权策略有警示意义，卖put时注意高溢价标的盈利风险

items.title: Fed Chair Warsh Testifies: US CPI at 4.2%, Rates Held at 3.5%-3.75%, July Hike Probability ~25%
items.summary: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh completed two days of Congressional testimony. CPI hit 4.2% YoY (highest since April 2023); Fed holds rates at 3.50%-3.75% for 4 consecutive meetings. CME FedWatch assigns ~25% probability to a July 29 rate hike. Warsh dropped traditional forward guidance in favor of data-dependence.
items.why: 高利率维持格局不变，七月加息风险仍在，全球估值压力延续；对sell put策略需留意高利率环境下delta对冲成本上升

items.title: Apple Intelligence Gets China Regulatory Approval with Alibaba Qwen & Baidu AI; BABA Shares Jump 7.9%
items.summary: Chinese regulators approved Apple Intelligence for launch in China via partnerships with Alibaba (Qwen AI) and Baidu. Qwen will power AI text/image features on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro in China. Alibaba US ADRs surged as much as 7.9% on the news, with Hong Kong shares up 3.26%.
items.why: 通义千问嵌入苹果生态，Alibaba(9988.HK/BABA)获得亿级iPhone用户入口，是AI商业化最重磅催化；在港股大跌背景下阿里逆势走强，基本面分化明显
